description: This file contains a class implementation for Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Resource, which manages resource autoloading, resource type definitions, and resource object instantiation within the Zend Framework's autoloading system.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Resource
classes.description: Implements autoloading and resource management for Zend Framework components, including resource type registration, class path resolution, and resource loading.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource autoloader with configuration options, ensuring required namespace and base path are provided and registering the autoloader.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Allows dynamic method calls to 'get<Resourcename>()' to load specific resources based on method name.

methods.name: getClassPath
methods.description: Computes the file path for a given class name based on namespace and component mappings.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Tries to autoload a class by resolving its class path and including it.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets configuration options from an array, including namespace and other properties.

methods.name: setNamespace
methods.description: Sets the namespace that the autoloader should handle.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the current namespace handled by the autoloader.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base directory path for resource classes.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base directory path for resource classes.

methods.name: addResourceType
methods.description: Registers a new resource type with its corresponding path and optional namespace.

methods.name: addResourceTypes
methods.description: Adds multiple resource types at once based on an array of specifications.

methods.name: setResourceTypes
methods.description: Replaces existing resource types with a new set.

methods.name: getResourceTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the current resource type mappings.

methods.name: hasResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a specific resource type is registered.

methods.name: removeResourceType
methods.description: Removes a specified resource type from the registry.

methods.name: clearResourceTypes
methods.description: Clears all registered resource types and components.

methods.name: setDefaultResourceType
methods.description: Sets the default resource type to use when calling load() without a specified type.

methods.name: getDefaultResourceType
methods.description: Retrieves the current default resource type.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns an instance of the specified resource class. If already loaded, returns cached instance.
